errors.evidence: The description fails to explain that the chart is a combination chart that plots two different types of data with different units (absolute number of cars and percentage) against what are effectively two different y-axes (one explicit, one implicit). By describing a single y-axis for the number of cars and then listing percentage values, it creates the misleading impression that the percentages are plotted against the primary axis, which is incorrect.
The description identifies the bars for percentage as 'оранжеви' (orange), when they are more accurately described as light brown, tan, or 'жълти' (yellow) as in the reference description.
The description fails to mention the placeholder label 'Axis Title' present on the x-axis.
